question: Which Assamese playback singer was conferred with the Bharat Ratna in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhupen Hazarika**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** was an acclaimed Assamese playback singer, lyricist, musician, poet, and filmmaker.
 
• He was conferred with the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in 2019.
 
• Bhupen Hazarika's contributions to Indian music and culture are immense, and he is known for his soulful songs that often conveyed social messages.
 
• He has also been honored with several other awards, including the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan.
 
• His music and legacy continue to inspire generations of artists and music lovers in India and beyond.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** was born on September 8, 1926, in Sadiya, Assam.
 
• He completed his education at Banaras Hindu University and later earned a PhD from Columbia University.
 
• Hazarika was also a prominent figure in Assam's cultural and political landscape, contributing significantly to the state's identity.
 
• He passed away on November 5, 2011, but his music and contributions continue to live on.
 
• His song "Bistirno Parore" is one of his most famous works and is still widely celebrated.
